text: Academic citation networks do attribute foundational contributions, but they depend on centralized institutional contexts with stable identities and long horizons, and they suffer citation gaming, prestige bias, and poor real time quality assessment.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
